start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj perimeter padhenge. Aapko maths mein kaunsa topic interesting lagta hai?

turns.reply: Board par triangle dekhiye: teen seedhi sides aur teen corners hain. Iski boundary ki teenon sides jodne par perimeter milta hai. Aap kitni sides gin rahe hain?

turns.line: board par ek dinosaur ka skeleton banao
turns.reply: Dinosaur ka skeleton ban raha hai—lambi haddiyan, poonch, chhota skull; kuch seconds mein picture aayegi. Ismein boundary kaise ginenge?
Ab dinosaur ke skeleton ki jagah vegetable patch sochiye: fencing ke liye boundary ki poori lambai jodenge. Aap pehle kaunsi sides naapenge?
